section.title: Four Pillars. One mission
section.subtitle: One brand. Four dimensions of Care

section.closing: Kindness Care cares. Kindness Longevity prevents. Kindness Academy trains, and Kindness Experiences takes care into new experiences. The four pillars have distinct roles, and they all fulfil the same mission: bringing more humanity to the way we live and care.

care.seoDescription: Personalized home support in Braga, Porto and Viana do Castelo. Home support, nursing, medical assistance and family support.

hero.title: Kindness Care
hero.subtitle: We care for people. We promote autonomy. We value life.

intro: At Kindness & Care we believe every person deserves specialized care, delivered with competence, closeness and humanity.
We support people who, due to age, illness, disability or temporary situations of greater vulnerability, need help with daily activities or specialized health accompaniment.

We provide personalized care in the comfort of home, through a team of qualified professionals, mostly nurses, with technical and human training and continuous updating. Our intervention is coordinated by a case manager, who ensures the articulation of professionals, continuity of care and a response suited to each person's needs.
More than delivering care, we seek to preserve autonomy, promote quality of life and also support those who care.

areas.title: Home Support
areas.description: Personalized accompaniment in activities of daily living, promoting comfort, safety, hygiene and well-being in the family environment.
features: Support with daily activities and light household tasks

areas.title: Nursing and Rehabilitation
areas.description: Nursing care and specialized accompaniment, oriented towards recovery, maintaining functional capacity and promoting autonomy.

areas.title: Medical Assistance
areas.description: Access to personalized medical care, facilitating clinical follow-up and articulation with other health professionals and institutions.
features: Articulation with hospitals and other health services

areas.title: Family and Caregiver Support
areas.description: We recognize that caring for someone is also a challenge for those who take on that responsibility. We accompany families and caregivers, providing guidance, listening and tools for more informed, balanced and sustainable care.

areas.title: Postpartum and Newborn Support
areas.description: Specialized accompaniment for mother and baby, helping the family live this stage with greater confidence, calm and safety.
features: Support with baby routines and care

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.intro: We believe the quality of care begins long before it is delivered. It begins with assessing each person, understanding their reality and building a truly individualized response.
commitment.methodIntro: That is why we work with an integrated methodology that involves:
steps: Assess — know the person, their clinical, functional, family and social condition.
Plan — define an individual care plan, adjusted to their needs and goals.
Coordinate — ensure follow-up through a case manager.
Care — deliver specialized care, with technical quality and human sensitivity.
Follow up — monitor progress and adapt the intervention whenever needed.
Empower — involve and prepare the family to take an active part in the care process.

closing: Kindness & Care is a spin-off of the University of Minho, created to transfer scientific and technical knowledge to the community, placing it at the service of people and families.
The phone line is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, all year round, in Braga, Porto and Viana do Castelo. Visits are arranged with you.
Kindness Care. Because caring is much more than providing assistance. It is recognizing the person, respecting their individuality and helping them live with dignity, comfort and autonomy.
care.imageAlt: Kindness & Care professional providing care at home
care.audience: For people and families who need care at home — because of age, illness, recovery or a period of greater vulnerability — and want to stay at home with dignity, safety and professional support.

longevity.seoDescription: Longevity programs: movement, nutrition, active mind and learning to live longer and better with autonomy.

hero.title: Kindness Longevity
hero.subtitle: Live Longer. Live Better. Live with Autonomy

intro: We believe aging should mean continuing to discover, learn, take part and enjoy life.
Kindness Longevity promotes healthy, active aging through learning experiences, physical activity and cognitive stimulation that help preserve health, autonomy and quality of life.
We develop programs and activities oriented towards different dimensions of well-being:

areas.title: Movement and Vitality
areas.description: Adapted physical activity classes, oriented towards improving mobility, strength, balance and coordination, helping preserve functional capacity and independence in daily life.

areas.title: Learning to Age
areas.description: Learning and sharing sessions about the aging process, with tools and knowledge to live this stage of life more consciously, actively and positively.

areas.title: Nutrition and Well-being
areas.description: Food education classes and sessions, with specialized guidance, promoting healthy nutritional habits suited to each stage of life.

areas.title: Active Mind
areas.description: Cognitive stimulation activities designed to exercise memory, attention, reasoning and other mental abilities, encouraging continuous learning.

areas.title: Conferences and Gatherings
areas.description: Moments of reflection, knowledge sharing and debate, with invited specialists, on health, longevity, aging and quality of life.

closing: At Kindness Longevity, we do not only want to add years to life. We want to add life to the years.
longevity.imageAlt: Couple walking, an image of active aging
longevity.audience: For people and families who want to age with autonomy and do not yet have a public session calendar. Contact us to find out when the next conversation is.

academy.seoDescription: Training for professionals, families and informal caregivers. Knowledge that empowers and transforms care.

hero.title: Kindness Academy
hero.subtitle: Knowledge that empowers. Training that transforms care.

intro: We believe that caring well requires knowledge, preparation and human sensitivity.
Kindness Academy was born from the desire to share knowledge and develop skills in care and health, contributing to more qualified, safe and humanized care delivery.
We promote training for Kindness collaborators, families and informal caregivers as well as professionals, adapted to the needs and challenges of each context.
Our training actions are developed and led by qualified professionals with experience in their fields, ensuring a technical, practical approach oriented to the reality of those who care.

areas.title: Professional Training
areas.description: Development and updating of technical and human skills of our collaborators and other professionals, promoting excellence, safety and quality of care.

areas.title: Family and Informal Caregiver Training
areas.description: Practical training for families and people who care for someone close, providing knowledge and tools so they can care with greater confidence, safety and calm.

areas.title: Workshops and Specialized Training
areas.description: Thematic sessions and training programs on health, aging, dependency, mobility, risk prevention, personal care and well-being.

areas.title: Knowledge Sharing
areas.description: Initiatives that bring professionals, families and the community together, valuing continuous learning and the dissemination of good practices in care.

closing: At Kindness Academy, we believe that the better prepared those who care are, the better cared for those who need it will be.
academy.audience: For professionals, families and caregivers who want home-support training. Dates are confirmed in conversation, because there is no public calendar yet.

experiences.seoDescription: Specialized support during stays and travel. Partnership with Pousadas de Portugal for safer, calmer experiences.

hero.title: Kindness Experiences
hero.subtitle: Travel, enjoy and live experiences with greater peace of mind.

intro: We believe that health or mobility limitations should not prevent people from traveling, resting and enjoying new experiences.
Kindness Experiences brings healthcare and well-being closer to tourism and hospitality, providing specialized support to those who need additional care during stays and trips.

We work with hotels and tourism partners to develop accompaniment and assistance solutions adapted to each person's needs, so guests and their families can enjoy the experience with greater safety, comfort and calm.

areas.title: Personalized Support and Accompaniment
areas.description: Individual accompaniment for guests who need additional support during their stay, respecting their needs and preferences.

areas.title: Nursing Care
areas.description: Nursing care at the place of accommodation, provided by qualified professionals whenever the guest's needs justify it.

areas.title: Mobility and Autonomy Support
areas.description: Assistance with daily activities, contributing to a more comfortable, safe and independent stay.

areas.title: Hospitality and Tourism Solutions
areas.description: Partnerships with hotels, tourism units and other operators, creating specialized responses for guests with specific health and well-being needs.

areas.title: Partnerships that Create Value
areas.description: Kindness & Care established a partnership with Pousadas de Portugal, bringing specialized care closer to hospitality and contributing to a more inclusive, comfortable and calm tourism experience.

closing: At Kindness Experiences, we believe everyone should be able to keep discovering the world. We care so that nothing stops them from doing so.
experiences.areasTitle: What a stay with care includes
experiences.audience: For guests and families who need health support or accompaniment during a stay — especially at Pousadas de Portugal — and want to travel with more safety and peace of mind.
